Create Lab Order.description: Creates a lab order (patient, sample and requested tests) in OpenELIS.

Create or Update Patient.description: Creates a new patient, or updates an existing one, in OpenELIS.

Save Test Results.description: Records entered results for an accession's tests (e.g. from an analyzer or another LIS).

Get Results For Accession.description: Fetches all test results for one lab (accession) number, e.g. to send back to an EMR or DHIS2.

Search Patients.description: Searches OpenELIS patients by name, national ID, lab number or date of birth.

Find Order By Lab Number.description: Looks up a lab order by its lab (accession) number to check it exists before creating it.

Get Patient By Lab Number.description: Fetches the patient linked to a given lab (accession) number.

List Results Awaiting Validation.description: Lists results waiting for validation, optionally filtered to one lab section.

Query FHIR Resources.description: Reads FHIR resources (e.g. DiagnosticReport, ServiceRequest) through OpenELIS's FHIR passthrough.

Get Test Catalog.description: Fetches the lab's test catalog, e.g. to map EMR test codes to OpenELIS tests.
Get Test Catalog.code:
// Fetch the configured test catalog.
http.get('TestCatalog');
